blue.limitations: The semi-upright position of the frontal radiograph and the single lateral view may limit the full assessment of lung volumes and the extent of atelectasis, especially in the posterior sulci. The overall image quality is suboptimal for detailed evaluation of subtle parenchymal changes. The images are obtained in a semi-upright position, which can affect the apparent heart size and make accurate assessment of cardiothoracic ratio challenging. The degree of inspiration is also suboptimal, which can further influence the perceived heart size. There is no prior imaging for comparison. A lateral view is provided, but it is not ideal for assessing overall heart size.
